Workspace proxies provide low-latency experiences for geo-distributed teams.

Aliases:

* wsproxy

## Usage

```console
coder workspace-proxy
```

## Description

```console
Workspace proxies provide low-latency experiences for geo-distributed teams. It will act as a connection gateway to your workspace. Best used if Coder and your workspace are deployed in different regions.
```
